# fr2052a_submission · compiled for PySpark
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = (
  spark.table("alm.fct_2052a_positions")
  .where(F.col("as_of_date") == F.lit("2026-06-30"))
  .withColumn("days_to_maturity", F.coalesce(F.datediff(F.col("maturity_date"), F.col("as_of_date")), F.lit(0)))
  .withColumn("maturity_bucket__days", F.coalesce(F.datediff(F.col("maturity_date"), F.col("as_of_date")), F.lit(0)))
  .withColumn("maturity_bucket", (
      F.when(F.col("maturity_date").isNull(), F.lit('open'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 1), F.lit('overnight'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 7), F.lit('d2_7'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 14), F.lit('d8_14'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 30), F.lit('d15_30'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 90), F.lit('d31_90'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 180), F.lit('d91_180'))
      .when((F.col("maturity_bucket__days") <= 365), F.lit('d181_365'))
      .otherwise(F.lit('gt365'))
    ))
  .withColumn("product_id", (
      F.when((((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("segment") == 'RETAIL')) & (F.col("insured_flag") == True)) & (F.col("account_type") == 'TRANSACTIONAL')), F.lit('O.D.1'))  # OD-1
      .when(((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("segment") == 'RETAIL')) & (F.col("insured_flag") == True)), F.lit('O.D.2'))  # OD-2
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("segment") == 'RETAIL')), F.lit('O.D.3'))  # OD-3
      .when(((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("segment") == 'SMALL_BUSINESS')) & (F.col("insured_flag") == True)), F.lit('O.D.5'))  # OD-5
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("segment") == 'SMALL_BUSINESS')), F.lit('O.D.6'))  # OD-6
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)) & (F.col("collateral_class") == 'L1')), F.lit('O.S.1'))  # OS-1
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)) & (F.col("collateral_class") == 'L2A')), F.lit('O.S.2'))  # OS-2
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)) & (F.col("collateral_class") == 'L2B')), F.lit('O.S.3'))  # OS-3
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)) & (F.col("collateral_class") == 'NON_HQLA')), F.lit('O.S.5'))  # OS-5
      .when(((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("account_type") == 'OPERATIONAL')) & F.col("counterparty_type").isin(['NONFIN_CORP', 'SOVEREIGN'])), F.lit('O.W.1'))  # OW-1
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("counterparty_type") == 'FINANCIAL')), F.lit('O.W.3'))  # OW-3
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & F.col("segment").isin(['WHOLESALE', 'RETAIL', 'SMALL_BUSINESS'])), F.lit('O.W.2'))  # OW-2
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'INFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)) & (F.col("collateral_class") == 'L1')), F.lit('I.S.1'))  # IS-1
      .when(((F.col("direction") == 'INFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == True)), F.lit('I.S.2'))  # IS-2
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'INFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & (F.col("counterparty_type") == 'FINANCIAL')), F.lit('I.U.1'))  # IU-1
      .when((((F.col("direction") == 'INFLOW') & (F.col("is_secured") == False)) & F.col("segment").isin(['WHOLESALE', 'RETAIL', 'SMALL_BUSINESS'])), F.lit('I.O.1'))  # IO-1
    ))
  .withColumn("outflow_rate", (
      F.when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.D.1'), F.lit(0.03))  # O.D.1
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.D.2'), F.lit(0.03))  # O.D.2
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.D.3'), F.lit(0.1))  # O.D.3
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.D.5'), F.lit(0.03))  # O.D.5
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.D.6'), F.lit(0.1))  # O.D.6
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.S.1'), F.lit(0))  # O.S.1
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.S.2'), F.lit(0.15))  # O.S.2
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.S.3'), F.lit(0.25))  # O.S.3
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.S.5'), F.lit(1))  # O.S.5
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.W.1'), F.lit(0.25))  # O.W.1
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.W.2'), F.lit(0.4))  # O.W.2
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'O.W.3'), F.lit(1))  # O.W.3
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'I.S.1'), F.lit(0))  # I.S.1
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'I.S.2'), F.lit(0.5))  # I.S.2
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'I.U.1'), F.lit(1))  # I.U.1
      .when((F.col("product_id") == 'I.O.1'), F.lit(0.5))  # I.O.1
    ))
  .withColumn("weighted_amount", F.col("balance_usd") * F.col("outflow_rate"))
  .groupBy("product_id", "maturity_bucket", "currency", "entity_id", "as_of_date")
  .agg(
    F.round(F.coalesce(F.sum(F.when(((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("days_to_maturity") <= 30)), F.col("balance_usd"))), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("gross_outflow_balance"),
    F.round(F.coalesce(F.sum(F.when(((F.col("direction") == 'OUTFLOW') & (F.col("days_to_maturity") <= 30)), F.col("weighted_amount"))), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("weighted_outflows_30d"),
  )
)

# materialize
(
  df.writeTo("reg.fr2052a_daily")
    .overwritePartitions()
)
